text:
alex: FYI perf regression on draft-model pairing with Mistral->Qwen fallback. Speculative acceptance rate dropped from 0.82 to 0.53, lat p50 +18ms.

alex: Logs show tokenizer mismatch — same prompt tokenizes to different lengths across families. KV cache warmup went haywire.

maria: repro? sample prompt?

alex: pasted sample and token diffs:
```text
prompt: "Summarize the API changes in v2.0"
mistral_tokens: [101, 305, 412, 77, 88, 999, 22, 7, 3, 5, 12, 4] len=12
qwen_tokens:    [101, 305, 412, 77, 88, 999, 2048, 22, 7, 3, 5, 12, 4, 0, 0] len=15
```

jamal: ran perf profile, kernel selection fell back to generic GEMM after mismatch; memcpy spikes on KV rebuild. profile snippet:
```text
kernel: fast_attn_x8 -> fallback: matmul_generic
latency: 24ms -> 42ms (per token)
memcopy: +11.2MB/s peak
accept_rate: 0.53
```

ci-bot: deploy/1721 passed for runtime-patch-47 :white_check_mark:

lina: possible root causes: vocab offset differences, byte-level normalization, or RoPE scaling diffs producing different tokenization boundaries. quick mitigation: align tokenizers at pairing time or force draft to use host tokenizer mapping.

maria: can we do a cheap heuristic to reject pairing if token length delta > 3? avoids KV churn.

alex: tried that on staging — delta threshold=3 reduces regressions but increases false rejects for very short prompts. numbers:
```text
threshold=3 -> accept_rate 0.78, p50 +6ms
threshold=2 -> accept_rate 0.71, p50 +4ms
```

jamal: alternative: warm KV rebuild asynchronously and stream early tokens from conservative decoder. patch idea:
```yaml
pairing:
  acceptance_threshold: 0.7
  async_kv_warmup: true
  kv_warmup_quota: 64
```

lina: also try forcing same tokenizer normalization step: NFKC + lowercase for pairing flows.

alex: ok i'll land tokenizer normalization + threshold=3 in canary. will monitor acceptance and token-level memcpy. thx :thumbsup:

maria: love short term plan, long term we need family compatibility matrix and per-model handshake to precalc token mapping.

jamal: +1. add perf test to perf-regressions with mixed-family drafting.

alex: noted. will open PR and add test harness. filing follow-up: https://redwood.internal/issue/INF-2387

lina: sgtm :rocket:
